# Get controls
```{r}
# Average wt and ddm1
all_tes <- all_tes %>%
  mutate(col_avg_wt = rowMeans(select(., matches("(ct_col)")), na.rm = TRUE))

all_tes <- all_tes %>%
  mutate(ddm1_avg_wt = rowMeans(select(., matches("(ddm1_ct)")), na.rm = TRUE))

# Create virtual F1
all_tes$virtual_f1 <- (all_tes$col_avg_wt+all_tes$ddm1_avg_wt)/2

# Get only accession specific TEs
filtered_tes <- all_tes[all_tes$V1 %in% accession_specific_tes$V1, ]
```

```{r}
filtered_tes$virt1 <- (filtered_tes$ct_col_6909_2_17614+filtered_tes$ddm1_ct_6909_3_17609)/2
```

# Run limma on virtual F1 
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Get all columns that contain "F1_ddm1"
ddm1_cols <- names(filtered_tes)[grep("F1_ddm1", names(filtered_tes))]

# Create a dataframe in long format
long_data <- filtered_tes %>%
  select(virtual_f1, all_of(ddm1_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("F1_ddm1"),
    names_to = "ddm1_column",
    values_to = "ddm1_value"
  ) %>%
  # Extract accession numbers
  mutate(
    accession = sub(".*ddm1_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", ddm1_column)
  )
```

## Upload sampledata and order it 
```{r setup{}

# Read data with filtered number of reads, at least 2 replicates and no misclustered samples
sampleData <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/filtered_data_wo_misclustered_wo_traps_2_repl.txt", header=T)
# Join sample data with filtered data
#Reorder in alphabetic order
sampleData<- sampleData[order(sampleData$Sample_id),] 
#Make rownames acession names
rownames(sampleData) <- sampleData$Sample_id
sampleData <- as.data.frame(sampleData)
#sampleData <- na.omit(sampleData)
## Select only F1 ddm1 and controls 
sampleData <- sampleData[sampleData$Genotype=="ct_col" | sampleData$Genotype=="ddm1_ct" |sampleData$Genotype=="F1_ddm1" ,]
```

## Import salmon data 
```{r}
library(tximport)

# Base directory for Salmon outputs
salmon_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/005_quant/all_plates_96w_salmon/"

# Dynamically construct paths for each sample in sampleData$Sample
sample_paths <- file.path(salmon_base_dir, sampleData$Sample_id)

# List all quant.sf files within these sample paths
files <- file.path(sample_paths, "quant.sf")

# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]

# Extract sample IDs for the existing files
fileSampleIDs <- basename(dirname(existing_files))

# Create a named vector for tximport: names are sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs

# Perform tximport for Salmon quantification
txi.salmon <- tximport(existing_files, type = "salmon", tx2gene = tx2gene)

# View a summary of the imported data
summary(txi.salmon)
# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampleData[sampleData$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id


##Subset txi salmon
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.salmon object based on the sample names
txi.salmon$counts <- txi.salmon$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.salmon$abundance <- txi.salmon$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.salmon$length <- txi.salmon$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
```

##Make limma+voom model
```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
counts <- txi.salmon$counts
# Paste count names
colnames(counts) <- paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype,filteredSampleData$Accession,filteredSampleData$Replicate,filteredSampleData$Request_id,sep="_")
new_colnames <- paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, filteredSampleData$Accession, filteredSampleData$Replicate,filteredSampleData$Request_id, sep="_")
new_colnames_unique <- make.unique(new_colnames)
colnames(counts) <- new_colnames_unique
## Create a virtual F1 
counts <-  as.data.frame(counts)
counts$F1_virt_6909_1_17222 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_1_17222+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_1_17222)/2
counts$F1_virt_6909_2_17617 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_2_17617+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_2_17617)/2
counts$F1_virt_6909_2_17620 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_2_17620+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_2_17620)/2
#counts$F1_virt_6909_2_17623 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_2_17623+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_2_17623)/2
counts$F1_virt_6909_3_17609 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_3_17609+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_3_17609)/2
counts$F1_virt_6909_3_17618 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_3_17618+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_3_17618)/2
counts$F1_virt_6909_3_17621 <- (counts$ct_col_6909_3_17621+counts$ddm1_ct_6909_3_17621)/2
## Add info to the count table

virtual_F1_data <- data.frame(
  Sample_id = paste0("vF1_", c(6909, 6909, 6909, 6909, 6909, 6909)),
  Request_id = c(17222, 17617, 17620, 17609, 17618, 17621),
  Accession = rep(6909, 6),
  Variant = rep("virtual", 6),
  Genotype = rep("F1_virtual", 6),
  Replicate = c(1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3),
  Number_of_Reads = NA,  # You might want to fill this with actual read counts if available
  Sequencing.date = c("2024-06-10","2024-10-18","2024-10-18","2024-10-21","2024-10-18","2024-10-18"),  # Using the same date as other samples
  Controls.deep.sequencing = rep("", 6),
  Plate.position = rep(NA, 6)
)
filteredSampleData_new <- rbind(filteredSampleData, virtual_F1_data)
```

```{r}
d0 <- DGEList(counts)
## Calculate cutoff factor (based on million reads in the library)
keep <- rowSums(cpm(d0) > 1) >= 3
table(keep)
```
## Virtual F1 VS real F1
```{r}
d0_filtered = d0[keep,]
d0 <- calcNormFactors(d0_filtered)
dim(d0)
# Calculate model 
variant <- paste(filteredSampleData_new$Genotype)
accession <- as.factor(filteredSampleData_new$Accession)
replicate <- as.factor(filteredSampleData_new$Replicate)
# Add sequencing date 
filteredSampleData_new$Sequencing.date <- gsub("-", "_",filteredSampleData_new$Sequencing.date)
sequencing_date <- as.factor(filteredSampleData_new$Sequencing.date)


filteredSampleData_new$comparison_group <- ifelse(
  filteredSampleData_new$Variant == "virtual",
  "virtual_F1",
  paste0(filteredSampleData_new$Accession, "_ddm1")
)

group <- as.factor(filteredSampleData_new$comparison_group)
design <- model.matrix(~0+group+sequencing_date+replicate)# Apply batch effect correction 

# Calculate variance in dataset 
y <- voom(d0, design, plot = T)
fit <- lmFit(y, design)

save(fit, file = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/limma_output/virtual_f1/fit_object_virtual_vs_real+replicate+sequencing_date_per_acc.RData")
head(coef(fit))
```

```{r}
output_folder <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/limma_output/virtual_f1/"
dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Get all unique ddm1 accessions (excluding the virtual F1)
ddm1_accessions <- unique(filteredSampleData_new$Accession[filteredSampleData_new$Variant == "ddm1"])

DEG_results <- list()

# Loop through each ddm1 accession
for (acc in ddm1_accessions) {
  # Create contrast
  contrast <- makeContrasts(
    paste0("groupvirtual_F1 - group", acc, "_ddm1"),
    levels = design
  )
  
  # Apply contrast and eBayes
  fit_acc <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
  fit_acc <- eBayes(fit_acc)
  
  # Get all genes
  all_genes <- topTable(fit_acc, adjust = "fdr", number = Inf)
  
  # Filter significant DEGs
  up_genes <- all_genes[all_genes$adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & all_genes$logFC >= 1, ]
  down_genes <- all_genes[all_genes$adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & all_genes$logFC <= -1, ]
  all_sig_genes <- all_genes[all_genes$adj.P.Val <= 0.05, ]
  
  # Save results
  DEG_results[[as.character(acc)]] <- list(
    all = all_genes,
    significant = all_sig_genes,
    up = up_genes,
    down = down_genes
  )
  
  # Write results to files
  write.csv(all_genes, 
            file = file.path(output_folder, paste0("All_genes_virtual_vs_", acc, ".csv")))
  
  write.csv(all_sig_genes, 
            file = file.path(output_folder, paste0("Significant_DEGs_virtual_vs_", acc, ".csv")))
  
  write.csv(up_genes, 
            file = file.path(output_folder, paste0("Upregulated_DEGs_virtual_vs_", acc, ".csv")))
  
  write.csv(down_genes, 
            file = file.path(output_folder, paste0("Downregulated_DEGs_virtual_vs_", acc, ".csv")))
  
  # Create a summary
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Accession = acc,
    Total_genes = nrow(all_genes),
    Significant_DEGs = nrow(all_sig_genes),
    Upregulated = nrow(up_genes),
    Downregulated = nrow(down_genes)
  )
  
  write.csv(summary_stats, 
            file = file.path(output_folder, paste0("Summary_stats_virtual_vs_", acc, ".csv")))
}

# Create overall summary
overall_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(DEG_results), function(acc) {
  data.frame(
    Accession = acc,
    Total_DEGs = nrow(DEG_results[[acc]]$significant),
    Upregulated = nrow(DEG_results[[acc]]$up),
    Downregulated = nrow(DEG_results[[acc]]$down)
  )
}))


# Print summary
print("Number of DEGs for each comparison:")
print(overall_summary)
```


```{r}
ggplot(overall_summary, aes(Upregulated))+geom_histogram()

ggplot(overall_summary, aes(x = reorder(Accession, Downregulated), y = Downregulated)) +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Unique TE Counts by Accession", 
       x = "Accession",
```

## Calculate heritability
```{r}
library(lme4)
model_random <- lmer(Downregulated ~ 1 + (1|Accession), data = phenotype_sum_with_metainfo)
summary(model_random)
```
